<?php

// Admin Columns only boots in wp-admin, and exposes its container on "ac/init".
// A pre-initialized hook captures it before WordPress loads.
$GLOBALS['wp_filter']['ac/init'][10][] = [
    'function' => static function ($container): void {
        $GLOBALS['ac_container'] = $container;
    },
    'accepted_args' => 1,
];
define('WP_ADMIN', true);
require '/wordpress/wp-load.php';
require_once ABSPATH . 'wp-admin/includes/admin.php';

if (!isset($GLOBALS['ac_container'])) {
    throw new RuntimeException('Admin Columns did not boot.');
}

wp_set_current_user(1);
$container = $GLOBALS['ac_container'];

/**
 * Same steps as the "Add column" button Admin Columns adds to ACF field settings:
 * the table's original columns, plus one column per ACF field.
 */
$add_acf_columns = static function (string $table_id, string $screen_id, string $list_table, array $field_names) use ($container): void {
    $id = new AC\Type\TableId($table_id);

    // Original columns are normally captured on the first visit of the list table.
    set_current_screen($screen_id);
    $headings = _get_list_table($list_table, ['screen' => $screen_id])->get_columns();
    $container->get(AC\Storage\Repository\OriginalColumnsRepository::class)
        ->update($id, AC\Type\OriginalColumns::create_from_headings($headings));

    $table_screen = $container->get(AC\TableScreenFactory::class)->create($id);
    $columns = $container->get(AC\ColumnTypeRepository::class)->find_all_original($table_screen);
    foreach ($field_names as $name) {
        $column = $container->get(AC\Acf\AcfColumnFactory::class)->create($table_screen, acf_get_field($name));
        if (!$column) {
            throw new RuntimeException("No Admin Columns column for the {$name} field.");
        }
        $columns->add($column);
    }

    $container->get(AC\ListScreenRepository\Storage::class)->save(new AC\ListScreen(
        $container->get(AC\Type\ListScreenIdGenerator::class)->generate(),
        $table_screen->get_labels()->get_singular(),
        $table_screen,
        $columns
    ));
};

$add_acf_columns('event', 'edit-event', 'WP_Posts_List_Table', ['event_country', 'event_speaker_countries']);
$add_acf_columns('wp-users', 'users', 'WP_Users_List_Table', ['user_country']);
